liability.quote: Where it is decided that student work displays some form of poor academic practice but not academic malpractice the academic marker will deal with this as part of the normal feedback and assessment procedures.

definitions.quote: Plagiarism is understood to include, in whatever format it is presented, including written work, group work or oral presentations, the following:

False Authorship is a form of plagiarism where misrepresentations are made on who created material, either by falsely claiming ownership of work produced or by attributing work to a person or tool (e.g. software coding) that did not create it.
Collusion occurs where a piece of work prepared by a group is represented as if it were the student’s own.
Fabrication or falsification of results occurs when a student claims to have carried out tests, experiments or observations that have not taken place
Retrospective detection is defined as the discovery of alleged academic malpractice in work that has been subject to final moderation, including by a relevant board of examiners.

It is an academic offence (termed academic malpractice) for a student to commit any act designed to obtain for themselves or others an unfair advantage with a view to achieving a higher grade, mark or more favourable outcome than they would otherwise secure.
